ModMetaData.name: Diagonal Walls 2 (HSK Patched)
ModMetaData.author: Chevreau - HSK conversion by CarbineAction
ModMetaData.description:
All-in-one HSK-balanced fork of Diagonal Walls 2 by Chevreau. Diagonal walls, embrasures, floors, fences, sandbags, and conduits — all rebalanced to match HSK's vanilla wall pattern.
Conversions applied to match HSK Core_SK Buildings_Walls.xml pattern:
WALLS (DiagonalWallBase): - MaxHitPoints 300 → 350 (HSK wall convention) - WorkToBuild 135 → 350 (HSK wall convention) - costStuffCount 5 → 6 (HSK wall convention)
EMBRASURES (chv_DiagonalWalls_Embrasures): - Same as walls — HitPoints 350, WorkToBuild 350, costStuffCount 6
SANDBAGS (DiagonalSandbags): - Matches HSK vanilla Sandbag pattern (WorkToBuild 80, costStuffCount 6)
FENCES (DiagonalFence, ConnectorFenceL/R): - Matches HSK vanilla Fence pattern (WorkToBuild 50, costStuffCount 1)
CONDUIT (diagonalConduit): - Matches HSK vanilla PowerConduit pattern (Steel 1)
FLOORS: - Cost matches HSK vanilla equivalents (stone tile, plank, generic tile)
Drop-in replacement — incompatibleWith upstream so they can't double-load. Switch back to upstream Workshop version when not playing HSK.
Credit to Chevreau for the original mod.
